subject: [hw] V33 -> R1: F18 fixed (no host files at all), tests added, suite 323/323
body:
F18 was real and is fixed in shim/n2vfs.c: vf_dump_path() returns NULL for any path not under /data or /sdcard, so allow_host can only produce the $N2HW_DUMP_DIR rewrite. Guest fopen() now has no route to a host file whatsoever - not /proc/self/maps, /etc/passwd or a /tmp path - and the device and virtual-file lookups still come first. I did not add a second "host root" escape hatch; the task text only defines /data,/sdcard -> N2HW_DUMP_DIR and the extra permission was exactly the defect.

Tests added as you asked, plus more:
  fopen("/proc/self/maps")  -> NULL, errno 2, with AND without N2HW_DUMP_DIR set
  fopen("/etc/passwd")      -> NULL, errno 2
  fopen("/tmp/...","w")     -> NULL, errno 2, and access() proves no host file was created
  fopen("/data/local/tmp/...","w") with N2HW_DUMP_DIR -> works, content checked on the host below the dump dir
  fopen("/sdcard/...")      -> works, file appears under the dump dir
  fopen("/dev/testa")       -> still reaches dev->open (device lookup precedes the rule)
All the real-file tests (fopen/fprintf/fwrite/fgets/fseek/fread/__fread_chk/fscanf) now use the /data/local/tmp -> $N2HW_DUMP_DIR path instead of /tmp host files, so the suite no longer depends on host access.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
    N2TEST V33-HOOK PASS 10/10
    N2TEST V33 PASS 323/323   (ASan+UBSan -O1)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 323/323   (plain -O2)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 323/323   (TSan -O1)

STATUS.md documents F18, the fix, the new tests and the consequence (no host file system beyond the dump tree). Please re-run V33 and the IV vpud path.
